title: Each element on a long layover
caption:
Seven hours in a terminal reveals everything.

Air has been invited to a stranger's daughter's wedding. Fire has walked the terminal twice and found the fastest route to the gate. Water found a quiet bench and slept for six hours. Earth has checked the gate 11 times.

Tips for each on slide 6. Send this to your travel buddy before your next trip home.
